source: Orientation pieces recoloured by exact hex swap (records_kit.py), new pieces from shared_pieces.py, Records landmark; build_records.py

entries.name: floor_j
entries.note: Records floor, slab corner: joint on the top row and the left column. Pale sea blue, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_h
entries.note: Records floor, slab edge: joint on the top row. Pale sea blue, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_v
entries.note: Records floor, slab edge: joint on the left column. Pale sea blue, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_p
entries.note: Records floor, slab interior, plain. Pale sea blue, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_chip
entries.note: 2x1 px wear mark on the floor layer; placed with a pixel offset

entries.name: route_inlay
entries.note: 1 px inlay line in the deep sea-blue floor step that guides the eye along the route; repeat every 16 px (horizontal). One step darker than Orientation's, because the Records floor is darker and cooler

entries.name: route_inlay_v
entries.note: route_inlay turned 90 degrees: the same line for vertical corridor edges

entries.name: route_arrow_e
entries.note: cherry wayfinding arrow inlaid in the floor, pointing east; Records signage uses the wood ramp, not brass

entries.name: route_arrow_n
entries.note: the same arrow pointing north

entries.name: wall_n_plain
entries.note: north wall segment: ink cap with a lit trim, linen face, baseboard and cast shadow; tiles horizontally

entries.name: wall_n_window_a
entries.note: high window overlay for the north wall: dark frame, cool lower pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill

entries.name: wall_n_window_b
entries.note: high window overlay for the north wall: dark frame, cool lower pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill

entries.name: wall_e_plain
entries.note: east wall segment, side plane; tiles vertically. Content starts 4 px into the first cell

entries.name: archive_door_closed
entries.note: both glass leaves shut: cherry frame, leaves, seam, pulls, linen RECORDS sign with a coral folder

entries.name: archive_door_half
entries.note: leaves slid 8 px into the jamb pockets: the corridor and a cabinet show through

entries.name: archive_door_open
entries.note: leaves fully in the pockets (15 px): the doorway is open and the threshold is lit

entries.name: lamp
entries.note: floor lamp: dark post, linen lamp head with one lit step, contact shadow

entries.name: lamp_off
entries.note: unlit lamp: head in the ink ramp, no glow

entries.name: lamp_glow_on
entries.note: glow, one hard linen step (radius 5.2). Paints only where the floor is the bare fill #BCD0D4, so it never washes over joints, inlays, props or walls

entries.name: lamp_glow_pulse
entries.note: pulse frame of the glow, radius 6.4; alternate with lamp_glow_on at about 600 ms each

entries.name: desk_a
entries.note: two-cell cherry desk with monitor, keyboard, paper and a small plant (a and b differ only in the plant leaves); the chair is a separate entry

entries.name: desk_b
entries.note: two-cell cherry desk with monitor, keyboard, paper and a small plant (a and b differ only in the plant leaves); the chair is a separate entry

entries.name: chair
entries.note: sea-blue task chair seen from above; place 11 px right and 18 px below a desk origin

entries.name: pot_plant_a
entries.note: slate planter with a dusty-sage plant; four leaf layouts (a to d)

entries.name: pot_plant_b
entries.note: slate planter with a dusty-sage plant; four leaf layouts (a to d)

entries.name: pot_plant_c
entries.note: slate planter with a dusty-sage plant; four leaf layouts (a to d)

entries.name: pot_plant_d
entries.note: slate planter with a dusty-sage plant; four leaf layouts (a to d)

entries.name: shelf_1x1
entries.note: 1-cell archive shelving: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in colour clusters (coral, linen, sea blue, cherry), kick plate

entries.name: shelf_2x1_a
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in colour clusters (coral, linen, sea blue, cherry), kick plate; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: shelf_2x1_b
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving: top plane, front face with three bays, boxes in colour clusters (coral, linen, sea blue, cherry), kick plate; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: partition_1x1
entries.note: free-standing glass partition, one cell: dark frame with lit cap, cool pane, one reflection band, floor rail

entries.name: partition_2x1
entries.note: free-standing glass partition, two cells, with a middle post and a reflection band per pane

entries.name: terminal_desk
entries.note: two-cell console desk: ink terminal housing first, then a screen with one body step and one lit step in the glass ramp, a one-step glow on the desk top, keyboard and card reader

entries.name: cabinet_1x1
entries.note: cherry filing cabinet, one cell: paper stack on the top plane, three drawers with label plates

entries.name: cabinet_2x1
entries.note: cherry filing cabinet, two cells wide

entries.name: light_shaft
entries.note: two bands of daylight falling from a window pair to the lower right, one hard linen step; paints only on the bare floor fill, so shelves, desks and joints stay untouched. Place at the window's bottom-left

entries.name: file_wall_closed
entries.note: two shelf units meet in the middle (cells 1-4 block); the wall reads as one run of shelving. Contact shadows are baked per unit

entries.name: file_wall_open
entries.note: the units have slid one cell outward along the rail (cells 0-1 and 4-5 block); cells 2-3 are a two-cell corridor. Contact shadows are baked per unit

entries.name: file_wall_rail
entries.note: floor rail the file wall slides on, with end stops. Place at the same cell as the file wall, 12 px below the sprite top; it shows in the open state

entries.name: archive_ring_inlay
entries.note: floor inlay: two sea-blue rings around the desk, echoing the luminous ceiling ring

entries.name: archive_desk_back
entries.note: the ring desk's north half: cherry top plane with an inlaid line, panelled face, inner north face, cast shadow. Carries the collision of the whole desk; people walk in through the opening to the south

entries.name: archive_desk_front
entries.note: the ring desk's south arc, drawn after actors so a person standing inside is hidden by the near desk edge; one cell opening at the bottom centre

entries.name: archive_desk_items
entries.note: card-index drawer, small terminal, stamp and ink pad, on the north half

entries.name: archive_ledger_before
entries.note: before: open ledger with a coral cross, the stamp mark rejected

entries.name: archive_ledger_after
entries.note: after: the same ledger with a coral tick and a stamped seal, the mark accepted

entries.name: archive_folders_before
entries.note: before: two folder stacks, every folder and label the same dull linen

entries.name: archive_folders_after
entries.note: after: the same stacks, labels regained: coral, sea blue and linen folders with lit label tabs

entries.name: archive_ring_glow_after
entries.note: after: the luminous ceiling ring lights a linen pool on the floor inside the inlay; paints only on the bare floor fill

entries.name: repair_door_closed
entries.note: the level 07 repair door, a north-wall door 32 x 34 px that replaces two plain wall tiles: a display band with two clear text windows (the address line with its cursor, and the two sides of the cursor: Backspace chevron left, Forward Delete chevron right), then cherry leaves with glass panes. both cherry leaves shut: the leaves meet at a seam with pulls and glass panes. Closed and half block; open walks. No flashing failure state

entries.name: repair_door_half
entries.note: the level 07 repair door, a north-wall door 32 x 34 px that replaces two plain wall tiles: a display band with two clear text windows (the address line with its cursor, and the two sides of the cursor: Backspace chevron left, Forward Delete chevron right), then cherry leaves with glass panes. leaves slid 6 px into the jamb pockets: the lit archive shows in the gap. Closed and half block; open walks. No flashing failure state

entries.name: repair_door_open
entries.note: the level 07 repair door, a north-wall door 32 x 34 px that replaces two plain wall tiles: a display band with two clear text windows (the address line with its cursor, and the two sides of the cursor: Backspace chevron left, Forward Delete chevron right), then cherry leaves with glass panes. leaves nearly in the pockets: a lit archive with shelf-end stripes and a mat shows through, and the threshold is lit. Closed and half block; open walks. No flashing failure state

entries.name: shelf_end_light_off
entries.note: a 6 x 12 end-of-shelf light (level 07: shelf-end lights change when the door answers). off: dull sea-blue glass. Place against the end of a shelf unit, one cell wide, no collision

entries.name: shelf_end_light_on
entries.note: a 6 x 12 end-of-shelf light (level 07: shelf-end lights change when the door answers). on: a linen core with a peach edge (not gold: gold is the UI's opened-route marker). Place against the end of a shelf unit, one cell wide, no collision

entries.name: courier_chute_idle
entries.note: Mira's courier chute, 2 x 1: a metal cabinet with a slot, a tube rising into the ceiling, a catch tray and an indicator lamp. idle: the lamp is dull, the slot empty

entries.name: courier_chute_ready
entries.note: Mira's courier chute, 2 x 1: a metal cabinet with a slot, a tube rising into the ceiling, a catch tray and an indicator lamp. ready (Mira has a route to offer): a slip stands in the slot and the lamp is lit in coral

entries.name: folder_rack_drift
entries.note: a low open file rack, 2 x 1 (level 08): six sea-blue folders. drift: label tabs at uneven heights and shifts, uneven folders, dull labels

entries.name: folder_rack_aligned
entries.note: a low open file rack, 2 x 1 (level 08): six sea-blue folders. aligned: every tab on one line in a regular rhythm, linen labels with a coral mark

entries.name: ledger_table_before
entries.note: the two-sided ledger table, 4 x 1 (level 09): a long cherry table with an open folio along it. before: both sign-offs sit in the middle, the table is dull. Put one or two light_shaft entries across it for the beam of daylight

entries.name: ledger_table_after
entries.note: the two-sided ledger table, 4 x 1 (level 09): a long cherry table with an open folio along it. after: sign-offs at both margins, both ends lit (lit wood, bright pages). Put one or two light_shaft entries across it for the beam of daylight

entries.name: rolling_ladder_closed
entries.note: the rolling ladder gallery wall, 4 x 1 (level 09): a shelf cell at each end, a two-cell opening onto the stair to the upper gallery, a rail with wheels, a cherry ladder. closed: the ladder stands across the opening (cols 0-3 block)

entries.name: rolling_ladder_open
entries.note: the rolling ladder gallery wall, 4 x 1 (level 09): a shelf cell at each end, a two-cell opening onto the stair to the upper gallery, a rail with wheels, a cherry ladder. open: the ladder has rolled in front of the left shelf; cols 1-2 are free

entries.name: report_table_before
entries.note: the report table, 2 x 1 (level 10): a cherry table. before: Pace's grey summary alone (three orderly bars)

entries.name: report_table_after
entries.note: the report table, 2 x 1 (level 10): a cherry table. after: Noor has placed the original report beside the summary (cherry cover, coral spine, linen label)

entries.name: mira_decor_courier_loop
entries.note: Courier Loop reward (after level 07): a loop-arrow medal on a small stand; a desk decoration, 1 x 1, no collision

entries.name: mira_decor_archive_folder
entries.note: Archive Loop reward (after level 11): a coral desk folder with a lit tab and a sheet showing; a desk decoration, 1 x 1, no collision

entries.name: elevator_closed
entries.note: elevator, doors shut: two steel leaves meet at a centre seam, a casing with two lamps, a lit floor indicator, a lit LIFT mat in front. Orientation's module in the records ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_half
entries.note: elevator, leaves slid 6 px into the jamb pockets: the warm cab shows between them. Orientation's module in the records ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_open
entries.note: elevator, leaves fully in the pockets (11 px, a 1 px lip stays): the cab is open and the centre cell walks in. Orientation's module in the records ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_doors): 3 x 3 cells, rows 0-1 are the north wall, row 2 the lit mat. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns

entries.name: elevator_call_panel
entries.note: wall call panel for the elevator, records ramps (shared_pieces.elevator_call_panel): steel plate, small lit display, up and down buttons. Overlay on wall_n_plain (no collision of its own); place it on the wall face 9 px below the wall top, one cell beside the elevator

entries.name: desk_a_front
entries.note: occluder for desk_a: the desk's monitor and first 8 px of top plane redrawn on front_prop so a seated worker's lower body is hidden; seamless over the desk (same pixels). Place at the desk origin after the actors; seat convention in ORIENTATION_KIT_SPEC

entries.name: desk_b_front
entries.note: occluder for desk_b: the desk's monitor and first 8 px of top plane redrawn on front_prop so a seated worker's lower body is hidden; seamless over the desk (same pixels). Place at the desk origin after the actors; seat convention in ORIENTATION_KIT_SPEC

entries.name: artifact_carbon_copy_a
entries.note: Carbon copy A (Records level 08): a sheet with a coral header over its carbon copy. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale glass-step glint at the upper left as the inspectable cue (never a UI marker colour). No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_margin_stamp
entries.note: Margin stamp (Records level 09): a ruled sheet with a round coral stamp in the margin. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale glass-step glint at the upper left as the inspectable cue (never a UI marker colour). No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_uncut_index
entries.note: Uncut index (Records level 10): an index sheet with four tabs along its long edge. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale glass-step glint at the upper left as the inspectable cue (never a UI marker colour). No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_noor_annotation
entries.note: Noor's annotation (Records level 11): a page with a dry coral underline and a margin note over a second sheet. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale glass-step glint at the upper left as the inspectable cue (never a UI marker colour). No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: cabinet_gate_misaligned
entries.note: the level 08 gate, 2 x 1: two one-cell file cabinets pushed crooked across the margin-room doorway: one low, one high, a dark crack between (blocks both cells). Same sprite box in both states, so a swap never shifts a pixel

entries.name: cabinet_gate_aligned
entries.note: the level 08 gate, 2 x 1: the same cabinets squared up side by side and pushed 14 px back against the shelf line: the doorway cells are free. Same sprite box in both states, so a swap never shifts a pixel

entries.name: cabinet_labels_offset
entries.note: the level 08 log cabinets, 2 x 1: cherry log cabinet, sea-blue folders with a linen label tab each at uneven shifts and heights. Same box and footprint as cabinet_2x1

entries.name: cabinet_labels_aligned
entries.note: the level 08 log cabinets, 2 x 1: the same cabinet with every label tab on one line at the same inset and a coral mark on each. Same box and footprint as cabinet_2x1

entries.name: archive_ledger_mark_rejected
entries.note: the circular desk's open ledger with Noor's stamp mark, 12 x 7 px, an opaque overlay that covers the landmark's own ledger: a coral cross, the mark rejected (levels 07 to 08; the same pixels as archive_ledger_before). Place at the landmark footprint origin + (26, 4), after the landmark's parts; it lets level 08 accept the mark before the folders and ring change at level 11

entries.name: archive_ledger_mark_accepted
entries.note: the circular desk's open ledger with Noor's stamp mark, 12 x 7 px, an opaque overlay that covers the landmark's own ledger: a coral tick and a round seal, the mark accepted (the same pixels as archive_ledger_after). Place at the landmark footprint origin + (26, 4), after the landmark's parts; it lets level 08 accept the mark before the folders and ring change at level 11

entries.name: door_panel_address_idle
entries.note: the address panel beside the repair door (level 07), 1 x 1: a wall plate 15 x 27 with two clear text windows (the address line with its cursor; the two sides of the cursor, Backspace chevron left and Forward Delete chevron right), an input slot and a dull idle lamp. Blocks its cell; the player reads it from the cell in front

archive_door.note: play forward on approach, backward on leave; the same frames as Orientation's door, recoloured

lamp.note: glow states: off, on (steady), pulse (wider ring). Wake = off -> on; idle breathing = on <-> pulse.

file_wall.note: the sliding file wall. Slide each unit one cell outward over about 4 steps (4 px per 50 ms) when the review completes; the open state leaves a two-cell corridor.

repair_door.note: level 07: the door retracts when the address is accepted; play forward, backward when the player leaves. Only open is walkable. Do not place plain wall tiles under it

shelf_end_light.note: level 07: the shelf-end lights come on when the repair door answers

courier_chute.note: Mira's chute: ready while she has a route to offer

ledger_table.note: level 09: correct margins light both ends of the ledger table

rolling_ladder.note: level 09: the rolling ladder moves and reveals the stair to the upper gallery (slide it about 19 px over 4 steps)

report_table.note: level 10: Noor places the original report beside the summary

elevator.note: play forward on approach or arrival, backward on leave; only open lets the centre cell through (the same set as Orientation's, in the district ramps)

cabinet_gate.note: level 08: the cabinets square up and open the margin-room doorway; misaligned blocks both cells, aligned frees them

cabinet_labels.note: level 08: the repaired label tabs line up (both states block)

ledger_mark.note: level 08: Noor's stamp mark goes from rejected to accepted. An opaque overlay on the landmark's ledger, at footprint origin + (26, 4)

archive_desk.note: Records landmark: the circular archive desk under a luminous ceiling ring. Every part is a full-size sprite registered at one footprint origin, so a state is a list of parts; place them all at the same cell. The desk is split into a back half (rear_prop, carries collision) and a front arc (front_prop) so a person inside the ring stands between them.
changes_after: the folder stacks regain colour: coral, sea-blue and linen folders with lit labels (levels.md 11: folder labels regain coral and sea-blue variation)
the luminous ceiling ring lights a pool on the floor around the desk (levels.md 11: beneath the luminous ring)
the ledger's rejected mark (cross) becomes an accepted tick and a stamped seal (levels.md 08: stamp mark rejected to accepted)
all four ring lamps switch from the steady glow to the wider pulse glow
